newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Church stops condom giveaway during Honduras voting.
newsitem.headline: Church stops condom giveaway during Honduras voting.

text.p: Pressure from the Roman Catholic Church has led authorities in Honduras, which has the worst AIDS problem in Central America, to suspend a programme to give out condoms during primary elections, officials said on Wednesday.

The Health Ministry had planned to distribute more than one million condoms at polling stations when Hondurans vote on Sunday to choose presidential candidates for the 1997 elections from the top two political parties.

Honduras, one of the poorest countries in the hemisphere, has the worst AIDS problem in Central America. But magistrates of the National Elections Tribunal (TNE) said on Wednesday the condom giveaway would be suspended.
"The church used its influence to suspend the distribution of condoms in the elections," one magistrate told reporters.
